title.zh: 全部前缀问答仍可遗漏中途失续
title.en: All prefix questions can still omit an intermediate loss

statement.en: Two configurations reached from one origin pass the same tests of completed blocks and of every nonempty prefix, yet only one can lose its continuation midway; no prefix test reads the loss, and exposing the suffix where the course stands recovers it.
statement.zh: 自同一起点到达的两个构型通过完整块与每个非空前缀块的相同检验，却只有一个能在中途失去接续；没有前缀检验读出该损失，在路径所在处开放后缀即恢复它。

laws.en: Midway is a frame of six configurations and three moves, with no claims: enter takes origin to risky or safe, begin takes risky to ready or blocked and safe to ready, and finish takes ready to done; risky and safe are both reached from origin by enter.
laws.zh: Midway 是有六个构型、三个动作、没有主张的框架：enter 把 origin 带到 risky 或 safe，begin 把 risky 带到 ready 或 blocked、把 safe 带到 ready，finish 把 ready 带到 done；risky 与 safe 都由 origin 经 enter 到达。

laws.en: Read in blocks of the completed course, begin then finish, and in blocks of its nonempty prefixes, begin and begin then finish, risky and safe are alike, and so pass the same branching tests of those blocks.
laws.zh: 以完整路径（begin 后 finish）为块读，以及以其非空前缀（begin，与 begin 后 finish）为块读，risky 与 safe 都相似，所以通过这些块的相同分支检验。

laws.en: From risky, begin can lead to where finish cannot be taken, and from safe it cannot; every description whose equal codes pass the same branching tests of the frame gives risky and safe different codes.
laws.zh: 从 risky 出发，begin 可以到达不能 finish 之处，从 safe 出发则不能；凡相等编码都通过框架的相同分支检验的描述，都给 risky 与 safe 不同编码。

laws.en: No branching test of the prefix blocks holds exactly where begin can lead to where finish cannot be taken; tests richer than those of the prefix blocks are not excluded.
laws.zh: 前缀块的分支检验中，没有一个恰在 begin 可到达不能 finish 之处成立；比前缀块检验更丰富的检验不在排除之列。

laws.en: Read in blocks of the suffixes exposed where the course stands, finish and begin, the test that begin can lead to where finish cannot be taken holds at risky and fails at safe.
laws.zh: 以在路径所在处开放的后缀（finish 与 begin）为块读，“begin 可到达不能 finish 之处”这一检验在 risky 成立、在 safe 不成立。

laws.en: A description giving one code to configurations that pass the same tests of the prefix blocks has no reading of its codes that answers every branching test of the frame exactly.
laws.zh: 给通过前缀块相同检验的构型同一编码的描述，没有一种对其编码的读法能精确回答框架的每个分支检验。

hypotheses.en: One explicit relation of six configurations and three moves; the prefix blocks are begin and begin then finish, with no claims (an empty atomic vocabulary).
hypotheses.zh: 明确的六构型、三动作的同一关系；前缀块为 begin 与 begin 后 finish，没有主张（原子问题类型为空）。

hypotheses.en: The non-reading theorem needs no reduction; the impossibility of extending a description already merging what the prefix tests merge takes that reduction as a hypothesis.
hypotheses.zh: 不可读出定理不需约简；已合并前缀检验所合并者的描述不可扩展，另以该约简为假设。

does_not_show.en: The witness refutes the sufficiency of this prefix language only, not of every coarse description or generative grounding.
does_not_show.zh: 该见证只否定这一前缀语言的充分性，不否定每种粗描述或生成根据。

does_not_show.en: The non-reading does not extend to richer atomic tests or to codes not reduced to the prefix tests, which may keep the distinction.
does_not_show.zh: 不可读出不推及更丰富的原子检验或未约化到前缀检验的编码，它们可能保留该区别。

does_not_show.en: Reality is not shown to require these names of moves.
does_not_show.zh: 不表明现实必用这些动作名称。

does_not_show.en: The witness is restated on the core frame; its correspondence with the earlier periphery model is not shown.
does_not_show.zh: 见证在核心框架上重述；不表明它与较早外围模型的对应。

detail.en: Midway.same_prefix_tests and Midway.internal_loss: risky and safe pass the same tests of the prefix blocks, yet only from risky can begin lead to where finish cannot be taken, so the prefix tests do not read a loss midway (Midway.no_prefix_reading).
detail.zh: Midway.same_prefix_tests 与 Midway.internal_loss：risky 与 safe 通过前缀块的相同检验，却只有从 risky 出发 begin 才能到达不能 finish 之处，所以前缀检验读不出中途的损失（Midway.no_prefix_reading）。

next_delta.en: Translate what remains, tests and formation between descriptions with different internal syntax, telling semantic tests apart from tests a formation has actually acquired.

correspondence.zh: 两位置有同一已允许 origin/enter 历史来源；区别由真实可达中间位置与后续 finish 有无给出，不来自自由损失谓词。此为给定规律中的见证，不是经验观察。
correspondence.en: Both positions are reached from the same admitted origin/enter source. The difference comes from reached positions and the availability of finish, without a free loss predicate. These are witnesses under a supplied law, not empirical observations.

history.zh: 2026-10-15，整合 I3b（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述（Becoming.Granularity 的见证 Midway）。外围的 ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary.unfolding 以带重叠通配分支的匹配定义，编译后用 propext，凡提及它的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以见证在核心的框架 Midway.frame 上陈述：同样的六个配置、三个动作与六步，步为归纳关系。自同一起点的两支（Midway.shared_origin）在完整块中相同（Midway.same_completed_tests），在每个非空前缀的块中亦相同（Midway.same_prefix_tests，由互模拟给出，故同测不加前提），而中途失续是实在的（Midway.internal_loss）：前缀的检验无一读出该损失（Midway.no_prefix_reading），任何对较细检验精确的描述都区分两者（Midway.codes_apart），在所到达处开放后缀即恢复区别（Midway.resumption_recovers_loss），约化到前缀检验的描述不能扩展为较细检验的精确说明（Midway.reduced_prefix_cannot_extend）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；未证明外围模型与 Midway 的对应（该对应须提及外围的定义）。
history.en: 15 October 2026, integration I3b (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine (the witness Midway of Becoming.Granularity). The periphery’s ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary.unfolding is defined by a match with an overlapping wildcard case and compiles through propext, so no statement mentioning it has an empty axiom report; the witness is therefore stated on the core frame Midway.frame: the same six configurations, three moves and six steps, the steps an inductive relation. The two branches from one origin (Midway.shared_origin) are alike in completed blocks (Midway.same_completed_tests) and in blocks of every nonempty prefix (Midway.same_prefix_tests, by a bisimulation, so passing the same tests needs no premise), while the loss midway is real (Midway.internal_loss): no test of prefixes reads it (Midway.no_prefix_reading), every description exact for the finer tests keeps the two apart (Midway.codes_apart), exposing the suffix where the course stands recovers the difference (Midway.resumption_recovers_loss), and a description reduced to the prefix tests cannot be extended to an exact account of the finer tests (Midway.reduced_prefix_cannot_extend). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope; a correspondence between the periphery’s model and Midway is not proved (it would have to mention the periphery’s definition).
